variants.headline: Company lays off many workers
variants.body: The company {company} has laid off many workers. We stand with {target} against an easy verdict; a principled politics should also be a fair one.

variants.headline: A large loss of jobs at a company
variants.body: Many workers have been laid off by {company}. We stand with {target} against an easy verdict; a principled politics should also be a fair one.

variants.headline: Workers face a company layoff
variants.body: The company {company} has carried out a large layoff. We stand with {target} against an easy verdict; a principled politics should also be a fair one.
